nodes.description: Vault identifier set from vaultFactory.numVaults() at init; used for fee lookups and fee distribution.
Manager address with privileged configuration rights; if zero, only owner is privileged.
Address of the underlying ERC721/ERC1155 asset contract; target of low-level calls.
INFTXVaultFactory instance used for fees, pausing and eligibility manager lookups.
EnumerableSet of token ids held by the vault.
Mapping tokenId => amount recorded for ERC1155 holdings.
Fee distributor address; receives token fees and is called externally during fee distribution.
Owner address controlling administrative functions.
Array of deployed vault addresses, indexed by vaultId.
Mapping of addresses (e.g. zap contract) excluded from fees.
nonReentrant external entrypoint that pulls NFTs, mints vault shares and charges fees.
nonReentrant entrypoint that burns shares, charges fees and withdraws NFTs.
nonReentrant entrypoint that withdraws NFTs first then re-pulls incoming NFTs, charging swap fees.
Flash loan entrypoint delegating to ERC20FlashMintUpgradeable.flashLoan; invokes borrower callback.
Internal function performing eligibility checks and pulling NFTs from msg.sender into the vault.
Internal function sending NFTs out of the vault, using random selection when specificIds is short.
Internal function transferring fees to the distributor and triggering external distribute call.
Internal function making low-level call to asset to push an ERC721/CryptoKitty/CryptoPunk out.
Internal function making low-level call to asset to pull an ERC721 in, with CryptoPunks owner check.
Internal function deriving a pseudo-random index from blockhash/coinbase/difficulty/timestamp.
Access-control gate requiring msg.sender to be the manager or the owner.
Access-control gate requiring the lock to be off or msg.sender to be the owner.
Deploys a new vault through a beacon proxy and registers it, calling the fee distributor.
Sets per-vault fees; callable by owner or by the vault itself.
Clears per-vault fees; callable by owner or by the vault itself.
Owner-only update of factory default fees with 0.5 ether caps.
Internal deployment of BeaconProxy vault plus init, setManager and transferOwnership calls.
Internal share minting used by mintTo and the flash loan path.
Internal share burning used by redeemTo and the flash loan repayment path.
Internal share transfer used to pay fees to the distributor.
Eligibility check delegating to the eligibility module for the supplied token ids.
Caller-controlled address used for NFT pulls, fee exclusion, privilege checks and callbacks.
Miner-influenced timestamp mixed into the pseudo-random token id selection.
Unchecked-style low-level call/staticcall to the asset contract (ERC721/1155/CryptoPunks/Kitties), a reentrancy surface.
External call into the fee distributor (distribute) after fee transfer, a reentrancy surface.
receiver.onFlashLoan callback executed between mint and burn, a reentrancy surface.
Fee computation mixing per-item fees with array lengths (amount - specificIds.length) and multiplications.
Modulo by holdings.length() in random selection; reverts/undefined if the vault is empty.
Caller-supplied array of token ids to mint/swap.
Caller-supplied array of ERC1155 amounts (ignored for ERC721).
Recipient address for minted shares or withdrawn NFTs.
Number of shares to burn/redeem.
Caller-supplied ids requested for targeted redeem/swap.
Number of NFTs received or to be swapped.
Computed fee amount to charge and distribute.
Pseudo-random index derived from block variables.
Loop token id being pulled or pushed.
Array of token ids withdrawn from the vault.

edges.reason: mint() passes msg.sender as the mint recipient to mintTo.
receiveNFTs uses msg.sender as the source of the NFT transfers.
transferFromERC721 uses msg.sender as owner/source in the low-level pull calls and CryptoPunk owner check.
_chargeAndDistributeFees checks vaultFactory.excludedFromFees(msg.sender) to skip fees.
onlyPrivileged compares msg.sender against manager/owner.
onlyOwnerIfPaused compares msg.sender against owner when the lock is active.
flashLoan forwards msg.sender as initiator to the borrower callback.
setVaultFees requires msg.sender to be owner or the specific vault address.
disableVaultFees requires msg.sender to be owner or the specific vault address.
createVault checks pause state via onlyOwnerIfPaused(0) for msg.sender.
setFactoryFees is restricted to the owner, derived from msg.sender.
block.timestamp is hashed into the random index, making selection miner-influenceable.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault reads holdings.at(randomIndex) and holdings.length().
The modulo operation is applied to the random value using holdings.length().
mintTo calls receiveNFTs to take the NFTs before minting shares.
mintTo calls _mint(to, base * count) to issue vault shares.
mintTo calls _chargeAndDistributeFees with the computed mint fee.
mintTo invokes onlyOwnerIfPaused(1) before state changes.
redeemTo burns the caller's shares before paying out NFTs.
redeemTo charges redeem fees through _chargeAndDistributeFees.
redeemTo calls withdrawNFTsTo to send NFTs out of the vault.
totalFee uses targetRedeemFee*length + randomRedeemFee*(amount - specificIds.length).
swapTo computes totalFee from swap fees, count and specificIds.length.
swapTo charges fees via _chargeAndDistributeFees before the NFT exchange.
swapTo calls withdrawNFTsTo first so the user cannot receive the same NFTs back.
swapTo calls receiveNFTs after withdrawing to pull in the incoming NFTs.
receiveNFTs triggers external asset transfers (safeBatchTransferFrom / low-level pull) before accounting updates.
_chargeAndDistributeFees transfers shares to the fee distributor via _transfer.
_chargeAndDistributeFees performs an external distribute call after the fee transfer.
_chargeAndDistributeFees reads vaultFactory.feeDistributor() to find the receiver.
_chargeAndDistributeFees queries excludedFromFees before charging.
withdrawNFTsTo calls getRandomTokenIdFromVault when specific ids are exhausted.
withdrawNFTsTo calls transferERC721 for ERC721 assets.
transferERC721 performs a low-level call to the asset address.
transferFromERC721 performs low-level call/staticcall to the asset address.
The flash loan flow mints tokens then invokes receiver.onFlashLoan before burning.
The flash loan path mints the borrowed amount to the receiver.
The flash loan path burns amount + fee from the receiver after the callback.
createVault calls deployVault to create the BeaconProxy vault.
createVault requires feeDistributor to be set and calls initializeVaultReceivers on it.
createVault pushes the new vault address into the vaults array.
setVaultFees reads vaults[vaultId] to authorize the caller.
disableVaultFees reads vaults[vaultId] to authorize the caller.
receiveNFTs adds received token ids to the holdings set.
receiveNFTs increments quantity1155 for ERC1155 deposits.
withdrawNFTsTo removes token ids from the holdings set.
withdrawNFTsTo decrements quantity1155 for ERC1155 withdrawals.
_chargeAndDistributeFees passes vaultId to the distributor's distribute call.
onlyPrivileged reads the owner when no manager is set.
onlyPrivileged reads the manager address to authorize privileged calls.
onlyOwnerIfPaused queries vaultFactory.isLocked(lockId) for the pause state.
receiveNFTs requires allValidNFTs of the incoming token ids.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenIds is the parameter consumed by mintTo/receiveNFTs; fold into the mintTo entrypoint node.
amounts is the companion parameter to tokenIds feeding mintTo/receiveNFTs; fold into mintTo.
to is the mint recipient parameter of mintTo; fold into the mintTo entrypoint node.
amount is the share count parameter of redeemTo; fold into the redeemTo entrypoint node.
specificIds is the targeted-id parameter used by redeemTo/swapTo; fold into redeemTo.
count is the running total produced by receiveNFTs and swapTo; fold into receiveNFTs.
totalFee is the value passed into _chargeAndDistributeFees; fold into the fee-charging node.
randomIndex is local to getRandomTokenIdFromVault; fold into the randomness function node.
tokenId is the loop token id pulled by transferFromERC721; fold into that function node.
redeemedIds is the output array assembled in withdrawNFTsTo; fold into that function node.
